posts.text:
Your readiness report, explained.

About 30 questions, then one tile for each of the eight NCLEX client need areas, each with a band: building, developing, on track or consolidating. It is a direction for your plan, not a prediction of your result. Your plan is built from it, leading with the areas that need it most.

Which area do you think is your weakest? Tell us in the comments. Save this for later.

See your own report, free: https://www.nclexready.com.au/diagnostic?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=readiness-report

#NCLEXRN #NCLEX #NCLEXPrep #AHPRA #OBA #IQN #NurseLife

Want a dress rehearsal before exam day?

Adaptive mock exams of 85 to 150 questions, about 2.5 hours, with no going back, like the real exam. Each one ends with a readiness report for each area, and the rest of your plan rebalances after every mock.

Have you sat a full-length practice exam yet? A) yes B) not yet. Reply A or B.

Mocks are built into every plan. See which plan fits: https://www.nclexready.com.au/pricing?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=reel&utm_campaign=mocks
